allow: PowerShell($page = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.youtube.com/@Acarsua" -UseBasicParsing -UserAgent "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36"; $patterns = @\('"channelId":"\(UC[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{22}\)"', '"externalId":"\(UC[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{22}\)"', 'channel/\(UC[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{22}\)', '"browseId":"\(UC[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{22}\)"'\); foreach \($p in $patterns\) { if \($page.Content -match $p\) { Write-Output "$p -> $\($matches[1]\)"; break } }; if \(-not $matches[1]\) { Write-Output "Content length: $\($page.Content.Length\)" })
